weekend_race.race_comments: Corey Heim has won the NASCAR CRAFTSMAN Truck Series Championship Race at Phoenix Raceway, his 23rd victory in the NASCAR CRAFTSMAN Truck Series. Prior to the start of the race, the following vehicle(s) dropped to the rear of the field under penalty: No. 34 (multiple inspection failures). The No. 34 truck will also need to serve a pass-through penalty at their first opportunity after taking the green flag for unapproved adjustments made on Thursday.
